title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stock futures pare gains after July inflation data
India bonds flat, major move likely only after US inflation data
description: Indian government bonds remained mostly stable on Wednesday, with traders eyeing important US inflation statistics expected later that day. The local retail inflation for July edged up to 4.45 percent, while oil prices declined slightly following news of a ceasefire extension. Overnight index swap rates showed little change, reflecting expectations surrounding the upcoming US economic data.

title: Axis Bank raises $300 million via bonds
description: Axis Bank has successfully secured USD 300 million from international investors, aimed at bolstering its growth initiatives. With a coupon rate of 5.348 percent, the newly issued senior notes will be listed on the India International Exchange and NSE IFSC. This issuance aligns with all necessary regulatory standards, demonstrating the bank's commitment to growth.

title: Grasim Industries swings to profit in Q1, revenue rises 21% YoY
description: Grasim Industries reported strong Q1 FY27 results, with standalone net profit reaching Rs 247 crore and revenue rising 28% YoY. Consolidated net profit jumped 51% to Rs 2,146 crore, driven by robust performance across core and growth businesses.

title: Embassy Office Parks REIT to enter Nifty 500, become only investment trust in Nifty Midcap 150
description: Embassy Office Parks REIT will be included in the Nifty 500 and Nifty Midcap 150 from September 30, 2026, as part of NSE Indices’ latest periodic review. The REIT will also enter several other broad-based indices, potentially increasing its visibility and participation from institutional and passive investors.

title: TCS shares tumble 4%, wipe out Rs 35,000 crore after N Chandrasekaran resigns. What should investors do?
description: TCS shares fell nearly 4% after N Chandrasekaran resigned as Tata Sons chairman, wiping ₹35,000 crore from its market value. Analysts called the reaction knee-jerk, while technical indicators point to support near ₹2,000–2,300 and resistance at ₹2,670–2,700.

title: Lenskart Q1 Results: Profit zooms 182% YoY to Rs 228 crore; revenue up 34%
